requirement.description: The Tags constructor currently has incorrect validation logic that prevents proper handling of conditional tags and doesn't properly validate argument types. The constructor raises TypeError for valid inputs like Tags({"foo": "foo"}, If("MyCondition", Tag("bar", "bar"), Tag("baz", "baz"))) when it should accept this structure.
requirement.contract: The Tags constructor must accept a single dictionary argument and any number of AWSHelperFn objects (like If statements) as additional arguments. It should properly handle mixed argument types including dicts, Tag objects, and If expressions. The constructor should not raise TypeError for valid conditional tag structures.

requirement.description: The Tags.to_dict() method fails to properly serialize conditional tag expressions (If statements) into the expected AWS CloudFormation format. The method should convert If expressions into the proper Fn::If format with nested tag structures.
requirement.contract: The Tags.to_dict() method must properly serialize conditional tag expressions into AWS CloudFormation-compatible format. When an If expression is present in tags, it should be converted to the proper Fn::If structure with nested tag definitions.

requirement.description: The Tags constructor doesn't properly validate input types. It raises TypeError for simple dict arguments when it should accept them, and doesn't properly distinguish between valid and invalid argument combinations.
requirement.contract: The Tags constructor must accept exactly one dict argument (for tag key-value pairs) plus any number of valid AWSHelperFn objects or Tag objects as additional arguments. Invalid argument combinations should raise TypeError appropriately.

requirement.description: The Tags.to_dict() method doesn't properly handle the serialization of Tags objects in AWS service contexts like Batch JobDefinition and DynamoDB Table components, causing TypeError when they are expected to work.
requirement.contract: The Tags.to_dict() method must properly serialize Tags objects for use in AWS service contexts and should not raise TypeError when used in JobDefinition or Table components.

requirement.description: The Tags constructor has overly restrictive validation logic that prevents it from accepting valid inputs like multiple keyword arguments that should be treated as a single dict.
requirement.contract: The Tags constructor should accept keyword arguments and treat them as a single dictionary argument for tag definitions. It should properly validate and process these inputs without raising TypeError.
